phase_blind_barrier.consequence: Any premise invariant under independent packet phase rotations cannot by itself prove a smaller universal joint-correlation factor.

angle_interface.angle_requirement_scope: Sufficient for the conditional separate-energy upper certificate, not necessary for the actual target when A_Z is smaller.

source_screen.Ramare_weighted: The theorem depends on support and an L2 norm; the stated complex extension passes through absolute values and does not couple the two character vectors.
source_screen.Ramare_regular: The output concerns additive Fourier frequencies near zero and assumes a near-Brun--Titchmarsh-saturation lower count; no multiplicative-character joint theorem is stated.
source_screen.Motohashi: Theorems sum absolute squares or absolute values over auxiliary primitive moduli and retain o(1)/unnamed effective constants; they do not contain C_chi(Qprime) at one prescribed f.
source_screen.Zheng: The signed theorem averages q and a well-factorable d for fixed residues a1,a2; it does not isolate the prescribed growing primorial or the variable prime-residue mask Qprime, and constants are implicit.
source_screen.Szabo: The weighted real-part estimate is for one nontrivial character of bounded order and has o(1); current conductor family has unbounded orders and needs a simultaneous C_chi-weighted bound.
